name: Cartesia Managed Agents
desc: Hosted voice agent platform: no backend to run yourself
desc_zh: 托管式语音 Agent 平台，不用自己搭后端
solves: Running a voice agent means owning telephony, turn-taking and tool calls. Cartesia hosts the call and you write the instructions.
solves_zh: 自己跑语音 Agent 就得管电话、轮次判定和工具调用。Cartesia 托管通话，你只写指令。
best_for: You are shipping a phone support agent and have no telephony backend yet.
best_for_zh: 要上线一个电话客服 Agent，但手上还没有电话和语音的后端。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://cartesia.ai/blog (Cartesia's blog, 'Introducing Managed Agents') and）。 Distinct from the ledger's 'Cartesia' speech API entry (2024-01-01): that one is the TTS/STT API you integrate yourself, this one is a hosted voice-agent runtime with telephony, knowledge bases and tools. I used the explicit day-precise launch post. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方文档的更新日志把「Introducing Cartesia Managed Agents」记在 2026 年 8 月，2026-10-29 的博客是更晚的正式发布公告。 按规则预览也算首次公开可用，所以记 2026 年 8 月、月份精度。 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.cartesia.ai/changelog/2026 首次公开日期仅精确到月。
